title: Petition of Algonquin Gas Transmission Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 75C, that it be authorized to take by eminent domain under G.L. c. 79, such rights of way, easements or other interests in land, or other property as may be necessary and have not been previously acquired, for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and removal of said natural gas transmission pipelines and appurtenant facilities situated in the Town of Berkley, Bristol County and in the Towns of Rochester, Wareham, Carver, Plymouth County.
